title: Match Group to Present at Upcoming Investor Conferences
summary: Match Group is the global leader behind Tinder, Hinge, and other leading dating brands, helping millions worldwide build meaningful connections.
body_markdown:
DALLAS


, Aug. 23, 2023


/PRNewswire/ — Match Group (NASDAQ: MTCH) announced today that management will present at the following investor conferences:


- Bernard Kim


, Chief Executive Officer, will present at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference on Wednesday, September 6


at 1:50 p.m. Eastern Time


- Gary Swidler


, President & Chief Financial Officer, will present at the Citi 2023 Global Technology Conference on Thursday, September 7


at 10:30 a.m. Eastern Time


Live webcasts and replays of the presentations will be available at[https://ir.mtch.com/news-and-events/events](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=3951238-1&h=2834341257&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.mtch.com%2Fnews-and-events%2Fevents&a=https%3A%2F%2Fir.mtch.com%2Fnews-and-events%2Fevents) .


**About Match Group**


Match Group (NASDAQ: MTCH), through its portfolio companies, is a leading provider of digital technologies designed to help people make meaningful connections. Our global portfolio of brands includes Tinder®, Hinge®, Match®, Meetic®, OkCupid®, Pairs™, PlentyOfFish®, Azar®, Hakuna™, and more, each built to increase our users’ likelihood of connecting with others. Through our trusted brands, we provide tailored services to meet the varying preferences of our users. Our services are available in over 40 languages to our users all over the world.


SOURCE Match Group
